description: Verified payment calculation module with overflow-safe arithmetic

atoms.name: calc_subtotal
atoms.description: Calculate subtotal as price * quantity with overflow prevention

atoms.name: calc_tax
atoms.description: Calculate tax amount from subtotal and tax rate percentage

atoms.name: calc_total
atoms.description: Calculate total including tax from price, quantity, and tax rate. Uses calc_subtotal and calc_tax.
atoms.requires: price >= 0 && quantity >= 0 && quantity <= 10000 && price <= 1000000 && tax_rate_pct >= 0 && tax_rate_pct <= 100
